# Senior machine learning engineer

::: {.lede}
Applied ML, retrieval, and reliable production systems.
:::

I build machine learning systems from models to deployment. My professional work spans statistical learning, numerical methods, and production ML systems.

Alongside this, I collaborate on retrieval and LLM systems, including search and RAG pipelines, tool-using applications, ranking, and evaluation.

My work also spans computer vision and high-performance Python/C++ systems. Applied mathematician by training, with a PhD in the field. Based in Paris.

Independent open-source work in applied mathematics and statistical computing.

::: {.proj}
